summary: Renders a clipped 2D textured screen quad. Clamps the requested width and height to [0,256], sets up the clipped destination region on the surface global 0x007CDE08, scales the quad size to UV space with a 1/256 factor, configures the four corner UV coordinates via sub_553650, draws the quad via sub_553700, and wraps the draw in a conditional-state init/reset around global 0x008AFE18.

operations.description: Clamp width argument a4 into [0,256]: negative becomes 0, values above 256 are capped at 256.
Clamp height argument a5 into [0,256]: negative becomes 0, values above 256 are capped at 256.
Only proceed with rendering when the clamped width is > 0 and the clamped height is > 0; otherwise skip the draw and return the height value.
Set up the clipped render region: ClippedRenderRegion using the destination surface global dword_7CDE08 with the clamped width/height as the region size.
Convert quad pixel size to UV units by scaling the clamped width and height by 0.00390625 (1/256).
Configure the four corner UV coordinates for the quad via sub_553650 at corners (0,0), (0,h), (w,h), (w,0), passing texture-color arguments a11..a14.
Initialize the conditional state object global unk_8AFE18 via ConditionalInit before drawing.
Perform the actual draw of the quad via sub_553700(a6).
Reset the conditional state object global unk_8AFE18 via ConditionalStateReset after the draw.
Return the (clamped) height value as the function result.
